name: world
description: kathir world: a small multiplayer 3D playground

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @world/server" "npm run dev -w @world/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @world/server && npm run build -w @world/client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/shared/test && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/client && tsc -p packages/client/e2e
